description: Verify that TCP in SYN-SENT moves to CLOSED after receiving a segment with ACK+RST and an acceptable ACK number (RFC 793 §3.9 p67). 2 iterations exercise flag set ∈ {SYN+ACK, ACK} alongside RST
approach:
[Objective]
Companion of FLAGS_INVALID_03: when the ACK+RST in SYN-SENT carries a *valid* ack number (acknowledges DUT's SYN), DUT must accept and close — that's the canonical 'connection refused' response.

[Scenario — chronological]
Two iterations:
• Phase 1: tester emits SYN+ACK+RST with acceptable ack.
• Phase 2: tester emits ACK+RST with acceptable ack.
For each: DUT active OPEN → DUT SYN observed → tester injects → DUT must close (verify-probe RST).

[Pass condition]
DUT closes in both phases.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_p<n>_no_dut_syn — phase n SYN missing
• Fail_p<n>_dut_continued — phase n DUT did not close

verdicts.Pass: DUT closed on ACK+RST with acceptable ack in both phases — normal
verdicts.Fail_p1_dut_continued: DUT did not close on SYN+ACK+RST with acceptable ack
verdicts.Fail_p2_dut_continued: DUT did not close on ACK+RST with acceptable ack
